findings.summary: The substantive known issues remain published for identical source, but the only c002 known-issues document still identifies r2 and links only the r2 C++ waiver. No explicit r3 scope/history entry or r3-specific file was found. This is a publication-attribution gap, not a source/byte or header-dependency defect. Concrete repair: before publishing/finalizing r3, add docs/known-issues-c002-wave1-r3.md linking the shared issues, or explicitly extend the existing document to r3 with its waiver, v1.5 binding policy and the two bound-but-unused extra headers. Do not alter frozen sources/headers or sealed reviews.
